subject.title: feat(memory-lancedb): scope memory_recall and memory_forget + configurable thresholds

question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin permanently expose caller-selected scope keys, global-only unscoped behavior, and three new recall tuning settings?
rationale: Tests can validate the mechanics, but only maintainers can choose the durable memory isolation, automatic-recall and configuration contracts.

options.title: Sponsor the full design
options.body: Reopen or replace this PR after confirming caller-selected scopes, global fallback semantics, automatic-recall limitations and all three settings as supported contracts.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Split behavior-preserving threshold tuning from scoped persisted state and separately design a runtime-owned scope signal.

options.title: Keep advanced scoping external
options.body: Leave multi-context partition policy to specialized external memory plugins rather than expanding the official plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow the proposal
recommendation.body: Split behavior-preserving threshold tuning from scoped persisted state and separately design a runtime-owned scope signal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merge history makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for a permanent plugin product-contract decision.
